name: ledgerdesk
description: LedgerDesk — local-first accounting and inventory ERP

scripts.dev: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run dev -w @ledgerdesk/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ledgerdesk/db && npm run build -w @ledgerdesk/core && npm run build -w @ledgerdesk/reports && npm run build -w @ledgerdesk/tally-import && npm run build -w @ledgerdesk/desktop
scripts.test: npm run rebuild:node && npm run test -w @ledgerdesk/core && npm run test -w @ledgerdesk/db && npm run test -w @ledgerdesk/reports && npm run test -w @ledgerdesk/tally-import
